entityDescription:
IONA Logistics Limited is an Irish-registered company (CRO 771910) developing an autonomous drone logistics network designed to transform last-mile and middle-mile delivery in rural and hard-to-reach regions. The company provides a white-label drone delivery system for logistics operators, enabling them to operate cost-effective and scalable services that complement traditional van or ferry-based transport.
IONA’s technology stack includes proprietary hybrid tilt-rotor UAVs capable of beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) operations and autonomous handling hubs. The system integrates satellite data, Earth observation, and AI-driven route optimization to ensure reliable delivery even in complex terrain and adverse weather conditions.
The company operates from Ireland, with R&D and flight testing in Europe and the UK. It is currently conducting feasibility and demonstration projects under ESA ARTES 4.0, validating its service model with early customers including Streamline Shipping Group and Eagle Couriers.
IONA’s vision is to decarbonize and automate regional logistics by building an aerial network that extends the reach of sustainable transport to communities underserved by conventional infrastructure.

entityDescription:
Neoforge is an AI-driven advanced metal manufacturing company headquartered in Berlin, Germany. The company operates a proprietary physics-AI simulation platform combined with a vertically integrated production facility, enabling the rapid development and delivery of complex, mission-ready metal components — from CAD to qualified part under one roof.
Neoforge's end-to-end capabilities span component identification and design optimisation, AI-driven build preparation with first-time-right printing via Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF), post-processing (5-axis CNC machining, heat treatment, surface finishing), full materials testing, and metrology. The company's thermal homogenisation technology ensures consistent mechanical properties across different geometries, machines, and production sites, significantly accelerating qualification and transferability.
Neoforge supports a wide range of metals including nickel alloys, titanium alloys, aluminium alloys, copper alloys, and stainless steel. By simulating more and prototyping less, Neoforge reduces time-to-product by up to 90% compared to traditional iterative manufacturing approaches.
The company specialises in supplying critical complex metal components for European sovereignty applications, including space, defence, and high-performance industrial sectors. Customers retain full ownership of the developed production recipe, enabling flexible insourcing or third-party production at a later stage.

entityDescription: Quantumz.io is a private software and R&D company (a Polish limited liability company) active in quantum technologies, scientific computing, and optimization software. It develops hybrid classical-quantum and physics-inspired methods for combinatorial optimization, especially problems formulated as QUBO and Ising models. Its main technologies include VeloxQ, a QUBO/HUBO solver with a Python SDK for deployment on standard CPU/GPU infrastructure and future hybrid workflows; XaosQ/AIRS, a solver-based disruption-management platform for airline operations built around Time-Space Networks and mixed-integer linear programming; and QOS, a platform for heterogeneous quantum-classical workflows. The company’s technical work also covers physics-inspired optimization based on nonlinear Hamiltonian dynamics and simulated-bifurcation-type methods, rigorous benchmarking of quantum and classical runtime claims, and methods for certification of quantum operations. Overall, Quantumz.io operates at the intersection of software engineering, applied optimization, and quantum computing R&D, with application areas including logistics, aviation, scheduling, energy, and other industrial decision-support domains.

entityDescription:
Space It Up SCARL is a strategic consortium that aims to boost Italian space technology for the exploration and exploitation of space, generating concrete benefits for the planet and humanity. The company is based on collaboration between 33 entities among universities, research centers and industry. Space It Up SCARL was originally established to manage and coordinate the homonymous project funded by the Italian Space Agency. While this remains its core operational mandate, the long-term objective is to expand its portfolio of research and development initiatives and to consolidate its role as a stable coordination platform for the national space ecosystem.

The mission of Space It Up SCARL is to coordinate its partners, foster structured collaboration among universities, research centres and industry, and support the submission of proposals to national and international funding programmes. By operating as a unified operational hub, the consortium strengthens the competitiveness of the Italian space ecosystem and ensures that the country’s scientific and technological capabilities are effectively represented in major strategic opportunities.
Space It Up SCARL also aims to serve as a national platform capable of aligning and managing future initiatives across multiple technological domains. Through this integrated structure, the organisation intends to provide Italy with a cohesive response to the growing global demand for innovation in areas such as space exploration, autonomous and collaborative robotics, extraterrestrial habitats, Earth observation and human spaceflight.

entityDescription:
NaviGate develops, produces and commercializes innovative high-technology products and services for the space sector. The company focuses on onboard software solutions for autonomous orbit determination and satellite navigation designed to operate directly on spacecraft with minimal dependence on ground infrastructure.
Its core product is a modular and flexible navigation software capable of integrating multiple sources of navigation data, including GNSS signals, inter-satellite measurements and optical sensors, automatically adapting to the sensors available onboard the spacecraft. This approach increases satellite operational autonomy, reduces ground-segment operational costs and improves the accuracy and robustness of navigation solutions, even for complex missions such as lunar or deep-space operations.
The software is based on advanced orbit determination algorithms, high-fidelity orbital propagation models and multi-sensor data fusion techniques. It is designed for embedded and real-time environments and optimized to run efficiently on resource-constrained onboard computers.

entityDescription:
Four Dot Infinity (FDI) is a Greek SME specialized in the development of intelligent services and AI-driven solutions for Beyond-5G and 6G communication systems. The company combines strong research expertise with practical engineering capabilities, focusing on open, software-driven and disaggregated network architectures that enable automation, energy efficiency, and resilient operation. Through its active participation in major European SNS initiatives — including Unity-6G, 6G-LEADER, MARE, and 6G-CLOUD — FDI contributes to the evolution of AI-native network design, advanced RAN intelligence, and future-ready communication infrastructures aligned with European strategic priorities.
FDI maintains a strong experimentation and validation capacity through its O-RAN testbed, built on industrial-grade and open platforms such as srsRAN, Open5GS, Amarisoft CallBox and AmarisoftUE. This infrastructure enables rapid prototyping, realistic system-level testing, and demonstration of innovative concepts under operational conditions. Combined with its expertise in AI/ML-driven RAN orchestration, edge intelligence, and multi-domain integration, FDI is well positioned to transform research outcomes into deployable solutions, supporting technology maturation and integration pathways consistent with ESA’s innovation-driven programmes.

entityName: von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics - ML4F — Machine Learning for Fluid Systems
entityDescription:
The ML4F group develops mathematical frameworks for combining multi-fidelity data streams in fluid-dynamic systems. The core activity focuses on hybrid surrogate models that integrate sparse high-fidelity CFD with lower-fidelity simulations and experimental measurements.
Expertise in adjoint-based gradient evaluation and physics-constrained regression enables the construction of models that remain consistent with fluid-dynamic principles, providing a reliable basis for the analysis and optimization of complex engineering components.
With a focus on system identification and state estimation (e.g. Kalman filtering and Bayesian inference), ML4F develops integrated modelling frameworks that continuously reconcile model predictions with observational data. These approaches support efficient design exploration and contribute to the development of physics-informed digital representations of engineering systems for performance monitoring and prediction.

With a focus on system identification and state estimation (e.g. Kalman filtering and Bayesian inference), ML4F develops integrated modelling frameworks that continuously reconcile model predictions with observational data. These approaches support efficient design exploration and contribute to the development of physics-informed digital representations of engineering systems for performance monitoring and prediction.

entityDescription: DIET (Department of Information Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunications,http://www.diet.uniroma1.it) is a department of Sapienza University of Rome, recently established after the fusion of the former Department of Electronic Engineering (DIE) and Department of Science and Technique of Information (INFOCOM). It is a governmental organization under the directives of the Italian Ministry of University and Scientific Research. The permanent staff is of about 65 researchers and professors, plus administrative and technical personnel, temporary researchers, contractors, and PhD students. Turnover of staff personnel is related to people retiring and consequent replacing. As for PhD students the turnover is three years whereas for temporary researchers and contractors it is 3-6 years. DIET carries out research and teaching activities covering many aspects of Information and Communication Technology. DIET has an extensive scientific experience in active and passive remote sensing. It has performed activities for analysing and interpreting data (electromagnetic models, inversion techniques), designing radar and radiometric sensors, modelling environment phenomena. Remote sensing of the atmosphere by microwave radiometers (both ground-based and satellite measurements) and radar remote sensing researches for land applications have been developed in the framework of international experiments and projects funded by Italian Ministry of Research, ASI, ESA and Italian Civil Protection. Past experience on inversion schemes include standard regression techniques, as well as Bayesian technique and neural networks.

entityDescription: Argus Autonomy develops autonomous guidance, navigation and control (GNC) software for spacecraft operating in close proximity where GPS and continuous ground control are not available. entityDescription:
CGT is a leading Italian industrial solutions provider and the official Caterpillar dealer in Italy since 1934, offering a comprehensive range of products and services across multiple strategic sectors. 
The company delivers integrated solutions including sales, rental, and technical assistance for earthmoving machinery, construction equipment, infrastructure projects, extractive industries, power generation, oil & gas operations, and marine applications. 
Its nationwide presence includes numerous branches, workshops, and a highly specialized technical team capable of providing rapid support and spare parts anywhere customers operate.

CGT plays a significant role in the marine sector, offering a wide portfolio of marine engines, propulsion systems, and technical services designed for shipyards, commercial vessels, industrial maritime applications, and naval operations.
CGT provides complete propulsion systems, integrating engines, generators, auxiliary systems, and control solutions to support ship-building yards and industrial maritime installations.
Furthermore, CGT offers specialized technical assistance, programmed maintenance, and remote diagnostic services, allowing fleets and shipyards to monitor the health and performance of their equipment 24/7. This service capability ensures minimized downtime, rapid repairs, and long‑term fleet optimization

As part of the international TESYA Group, CGT benefits from a broad European footprint spanning Italy, Spain, Portugal, and the Balkans.
TESYA Group is composed of 28 companies with strong local roots across 15 countries. It is a market leader in providing sophisticated, highly customized B2B solutions for construction, logistics, warehouse management, major event organization, mechanical and electrical power generation, and energy transition. 
With a 90‑year entrepreneurial history, the Group employs over 4100 people in 128 offices and leverages advanced technologies to deliver integrated, multi‑service solutions. 
TESYA’s purpose—powering the growth of people, business and communities—guides its focus on innovation, customer support, productivity, and sustainable value creation.

Open Cosmos is a company that provides end-to-end space satellites solutions including design, build, test, launch and operation of satellite missions and provision of satellite data and derived services.
Our main products and services are:
OpenOrbit: An end-to-end mission management service that covers the entire process of design, production, launching a satellite into orbit and its operation.
OpenConstellation offers a mutualized satellite infrastructure, enabling shared access to satellite data. This approach significantly reduces mission costs and broadens access to satellite data for individual organizations.
DataCosmos: An AI cloud-based data analytics platform offering access to satellite imagery and data from diverse sources. It features tools for data visualization and integration of insights into business workflows.

RFTronics UK Ltd is an RF and microwave engineering consultancy partnering with universities, SATCOM, telecom, and defence organisations to support complex technology programmes and help ensure successful delivery when technical and programme risks are high.
The company provides specialist expertise in RF systems, microwave engineering, and satellite communications, helping organisations overcome technical bottlenecks and accelerate development across advanced communication and sensing systems.
RFTronics UK also collaborates with industry and academic partners in preparing and supporting proposals for innovation funding, including programmes and calls issued by organisations such as the UK Space Agency and the European Space Agency, contributing technical expertise to the development of next-generation RF and satellite technologies.
